title: Newark：从深度记录到相对时间轴
purpose: A disclosed, workflow-guided demonstration using original Acycle MATLAB calculations and figures; not blind method selection or reconstruction of the published Newark chronology.
design_context: The existing v0.4 Newark depth-spectrum results were already known when this demonstration was designed. The fixed long-cycle band is justified against the cited regional literature, but this is not a blinded or independently preregistered cycle-detection study.

input.unit_evidence: Pinned code/guicode/AC.m, menu_example_Newark_Callback: Depth (m), Depth Rank.
input.source_attribution: Acycle v2.8 User's Guide p.38 attributes this exact example filename to Olsen and Kent (1996).

existing_matlab_observation.meaning: Metadata already reported by the original MATLAB baseline; no new Python scientific preprocessing.

middle_age_ma.status: demonstration approximation for age-dependent orbital target periods; not an absolute age assigned to any row
middle_age_ma.basis: The pinned upstream Newark comparison scripts use 210 Ma. Their newark2km-s-rsp0.85.txt is not proven byte-identical to this example.

rate_search_cm_per_kyr.status: exploratory search grid, not a measured or inferred rate
rate_search_cm_per_kyr.basis: Pinned runCocoPublicationValidation.m uses 5–25 cm/kyr for a separately preprocessed 0–800 m excerpt of this example; the coarser step here is a demo choice.

long_cycle_period_kyr.basis: Kent et al. (2018), DOI 10.1073/pnas.1800891115, supports the regional 405-kyr metronome using independent U–Pb dates and magnetostratigraphic correlation; it does not identify the cycles or absolute age of this particular example file.

depth_filter.status: literature-informed demonstration band, fixed before this run; Gaussian edges are not a sharp passband
depth_filter.basis: Kent and Olsen (1999), DOI 10.1029/1999JB900076, reports a mean thickness of about 60 m for the regional 404-kyr cycle. The 48–80 m width is an explicit demonstration choice, not a published confidence interval.

relative_time.coordinate_direction: relative time increases with the input depth coordinate; no young-to-old absolute-age orientation is asserted
relative_time.rule: First selected filtered maximum is t=0; successive selected maxima are assigned +405 kyr. Apply the resulting controls to the original proxy, retaining only the interval between the first and last controls.
relative_time.phase_meaning: A peak is an operational signal maximum, not independently identified eccentricity maximum or a dated horizon.
relative_time.uncertainty: Missing/extra cycles, filtering, edge behavior, phase choice, variable accumulation and hiatuses are not propagated into a formal age confidence interval. A trough branch is a phase sensitivity check, not a statistical confidence interval.

monte_carlo.status: quick exploratory budget; cannot demonstrate p < 0.05

time_diagnostics.input_policy: Use the original raw proxy, the actual tuning_run_id and its MATLAB control table; never use the band-pass output as the proxy for this diagnostic.
time_diagnostics.resampling_note: The 5-kyr grid is an interpolation setting, not evidence of 5-kyr effective resolution.

workflow_input_lineage.interpolate_pro: Consumes the untouched official raw input; retains its bytes and computes QA/grid/diagnostic in MATLAB. The requested 0.85344-m grid comes from the existing MATLAB metadata, not the different upstream 0.85-m record.
workflow_input_lineage.depth_diagnostics_coco_ecoco: All three consume the same actual interpolated_csv artifact from this run's Interpolation Pro stage. Retain its hash and link to the original raw source. Do not silently revert individual analyses to another input.
workflow_input_lineage.tune: Consumes the actual filtered_csv artifact of the depth diagnostic, including only its coordinate and filtered-value columns.
workflow_input_lineage.time_diagnostics: Consumes the untouched original raw proxy plus the completed tuning_run_id, and applies the saved MATLAB controls and valid depth range. Its raw-file hash intentionally differs from the formatted Pro artifact's hash.

interpretation_contract: A spectrum peak is an exploratory candidate, not an automatic orbital identification.
Report original COCO rate-global Monte Carlo results and resolved target counts; local p values cannot replace the global test.
eCOCO global p values correct the rate search within each window, not a search over all windows.
Monte Carlo inference is conditional on the globally LOWESS-transformed record; the original null routine does not refit that nonlinear trend for each realization.
Low-rate cells may leave short orbital terms unresolved at the original sampling interval; retain these cells and report the resolved count rather than silently narrowing the grid.
EvoFFT zero-padded edge windows and complete unpadded eCOCO windows have different edge support.
No all-NaN map, unresolved maximum, missing cycle, or failed stage may be concealed by changing parameters or presenting a cached successful result.
A 405-kyr peak after 405-kyr tuning is an expected consequence of the imposed controls and is not independent confirmation of astronomical forcing.
Time-domain features at other periods remain conditional on the same age model; they are diagnostics, not independent dating evidence.
No true Newark absolute chronology, formal age uncertainty, or blind paper replication is claimed.
required_deliverables: MATLAB Interpolation Pro grid/gap diagnostic and interpolated table, with raw-source linkage
MATLAB original-series/preprocessing figure and processed table
MATLAB depth MTM spectrum and EvoFFT figure/tables
MATLAB COCO rate diagnostics and original global significance outputs
MATLAB eCOCO map and rate-track table, including unresolved cells
MATLAB filtered series and extrema-derived age-control table
MATLAB relative age-depth/controls figure and tuned original-proxy table
MATLAB time MTM spectrum and time EvoFFT diagnostic
Original downloadable artifacts plus concise visible assumptions and conditional interpretation

presentation.opening_disclosure_zh: 我将采用演示方案中的公开先验，以405 kyr建立相对时间轴；210 Ma仅用于轨道目标近似，19次模拟用于快速探索。
main_story: 候选速率及沿剖面变化

validation.existing_evidence_scope: Version 0.4 Newark real Harness conversation completed depth-domain analysis and a separate detrending-span follow-up with MATLAB results and image/file delivery. It did not execute this complete 405-kyr tuning workflow.
validation.rehearsal_receipt_policy: Record actual run IDs, effective parameters, failures, duration and client rendering separately; do not overwrite this design with an inferred success claim.
